text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's the day of the second Classic
race—the
Derby!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Something about the Derby feels
way
different from other races.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I can't tell if the air feels super thin and
tense or
super heavy and foreboding...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
O-oh, c'mon! It's not like I'm nervous or
anything!
Well, maybe just a little!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I did tons of partner running to prepare
and
everything. There's no way I'm
gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If I wanna surpass Prez, I can't let my
momentum
die here!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, for sure! I can already taste my
victory!
